objective: Collect independently checked attempts and repairs across seven procedural task families under matched recurrence budgets.
context: Graph route, arithmetic program, constraint assignment, evidence retrieval, table transform, experiment plan, finite-state plan. Direct, RLT and matched damping modes; train/calibration and evaluation custody.

steps.name: Generate a world
steps.description: Define the public inputs, lineage and split.

steps.name: Propose candidate
steps.description: Explain both pool selection and freeform proposals.

steps.name: Recurrent update
steps.description: Specify planned clock, readout and feedback schedule.

steps.name: Verifier receipt
steps.description: Explain exact acceptance, rejection and repair feedback.

steps.name: Replay and export
steps.description: Bind source and task digests; preserve failed attempts and keep protected data separate.

specific_questions.prompt: Construct a weighted directed graph and prove a minimum route, including why a plausible competing route loses.
Trace a bounded conditional arithmetic program; identify a counterexample to an incorrect recurrence.
Construct a small assignment problem and certify feasibility or infeasibility.
Explain alias resolution and provide a checkable evidence retrieval proof on a toy corpus.
Derive grouped filtering, aggregation and ordered output on a small table.
Construct a feasible and a confounded experiment plan under a shared budget.
Solve a small finite-state planning problem with a state trace and optimality or reachability certificate.
Derive the RLT fixed-horizon coefficient and compare direct and matched damping under identical planned visits.

native_verifier: datagoblin.training_gym.rlt_gym.tasks exact check and runner replay.
